text:
katy-docs: heads-up — legal wants the v1 streaming endpoints deprecation notice live next week. we need: short announcement copy, migration example for node+python, and an inline snippet update for streaming framing and partial tokens. can we coord PRs? :wave:
ryan-engineering: i can update the runtime docs and add the framing example. quick q: do we show the old v1 streaming snippet or only v2?
katy-docs: include both side-by-side but clearly label v1 as DEPRECATED. add a small note about `prefetch_kv_cache` behavior change when swapping models.
sam-devex: i have a toy node example that demonstrates the stream-to-chunks flow. i'll push it as a separate example under `examples/node/stream-chunking` and link from the guide. PR will be in docs repo.
lee-product: timeline check — legal wants the public deprecation email 2026-04-01. docs MUST be done by 2026-03-29 for final review.
ryan-engineering: noted. i'll open a draft PR for the runtime page: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 (WIP). adding TODOs for snippet replacements.
katy-docs: thanks — please add an explicit callout about param rename: `streaming_mode` -> `stream_mode` (breaking; will return 400 on v1 endpoints after cutoff). include a migration snippet showing the rename.
sam-devex: sample node snippet (works with new v2 responses API):
```js
// examples/node/stream-chunking/index.js
const res = await client.responses.stream({
  model: 'redwood/fast-chat',
  input: 'Summarize log output',
  stream_mode: 'chunked',
});
for await (const chunk of res) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta?.content || '');
}
```
ryan-engineering: perfect. i'll mirror a python example and also show a minimal fallback to the non-streaming `responses.create()` call. mention that embeddings model aliases are unaffected.
katy-docs: Also, someone needs to run snippet smoke tests — ensure the node example runs on CI and that the output shape matches the docs test harness. sam, can you add a tiny test?
sam-devex: will add. test will run `node examples/node/stream-chunking/index.js` and assert lines > 0. will include a recorded golden output for CI flakiness guard.
lee-product: for the deprecation notice wording, propose this short blurb for the site and email body: "We are deprecating v1 streaming endpoints on 2026-04-08. Please migrate to the v2 Responses streaming API (param rename: `streaming_mode` -> `stream_mode`). See the migration guide and examples for code samples and fallback patterns." good?
katy-docs: looks good. legal asked to add rollback instructions: how to fall back if a customer hits errors — suggest pinning to `model: 'redwood/fast-chat@v1.9'` and switching to non-streaming path temporarily. add snippet.
ryan-engineering: added a short `pin-and-fallback.md` section in the PR. also noted that `prefetch_kv_cache` is default-on in v2; documented the toggles.
deploy-bot: Build status — docs-ci passed for branch ryan/streaming-migration (checks: 13/13).
katy-docs: awesome. last asks: 1) update the docs index with a one-line deprecation banner; 2) add redirect from /v1/streams to /docs/migration/v1-to-v2-streaming; 3) coordinate with marketing for the email subject.
sam-devex: redirects added in my branch for the example links.
lee-product: marketing will use subject: "Action required: Migrate from v1 streaming endpoints by Apr 8" — will confirm copy tomorrow.
katy-docs: OK folks — i'll bundle the announcement copy, final checklist, and the PR links in a short handoff doc by EOD tomorrow. please tag me on your PRs for final review. :thumbsup:
